summary.title: About Me
summary.summaryText:
My name is Artemiy, I am a Manual QA Engineer with almost 4 years of experience. My main focus is backend and API testing, but I also worked with UI, checking responsiveness, cross-browser compatibility, and data accuracy.

I worked as a tester on the Ipsilon project at Saratov State University. It was a distance learning system that combined the functions of an electronic gradebook, student and teacher dashboards, schedules, and course reports. The project included a full redesign of the platform, backend architecture updates, and mobile adaptation. My main responsibilities involved testing the backend and API, as well as verifying frontend interaction with the server. The system architecture was built on Ruby on Rails with REST API, React on the frontend, PostgreSQL as the main database, Redis for caching and session storage, and testing was carried out mainly in Postman. I also used Swagger, DBeaver, DevTools, and Charles Proxy.

In the project, I performed functional and integration testing of modules such as gradebooks, schedules, user dashboards, courses, and the notification system. I used SQL queries in PostgreSQL to validate data accuracy and cross-checked student scores with the values displayed in the UI. I also verified user roles — student, teacher, and admin — to ensure proper access control was implemented.

We worked in a small team under the Kanban methodology with two QA engineers, several developers, and an analyst. Tasks were managed in Jira — we clarified requirements, participated in acceptance testing, and reported bugs with prioritization based on user impact. After each release, I performed smoke and regression testing and documented all discovered issues in Jira with detailed reproduction steps, environment details, and screenshots.

I also tested UI responsiveness, checking student dashboards and schedules on mobile and tablet devices using DevTools and real devices. In one of the builds, I discovered that course cards overlapped each other in horizontal orientation — the issue was resolved by adjusting media queries.
strengths: Attention to detail and focus on product quality
Experienced in designing test cases, checklists, and bug reports
Able to quickly understand business logic and system requirements
Proactive in identifying risks and edge cases
Team-oriented, but capable of independent decision-making
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
